final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS wp, t.bandusagepct AS bu FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), g AS (SELECT wp, AVG(bu) AS avg_bu, COUNT(*) AS n FROM j GROUP BY wp), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bu) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.wp, g.avg_bu, g.n, g.avg_bu - m.mean_avg AS dev_from_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
